relevant_lines.text: Indian Institute of Information Technology Bhagalpur (IIIT Bhagalpur), an Institute of National Importance established under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, offers undergraduate programmes in Computer Science & Engineering (CSE), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Mathematics & Computing (MNC), and Mechanical & Automation Engineering (MAE).

The Institute functions from its dedicated green residential campus situated on the banks of the River Ganga at Sabour, Bhagalpur, Bihar. Students from across India join IIIT Bhagalpur every year, contributing to a vibrant academic and cultural environment.

Admission to the B.Tech programmes of IIIT Bhagalpur is conducted through the counselling processes of JoSAA 2026 (https://josaa.nic.in/), CSAB 2026 (https://csab.nic.in/), and DASA 2026, as applicable. Candidates are advised to regularly visit the respective counselling portals and the Institute website for updates.

Candidates allotted a seat at IIIT Bhagalpur through JoSAA 2026, CSAB 2026, or DASA 2026 may refer to the following information regarding registration, fee payment, hostel allotment, reporting, and induction program:
Click Here To download the List of documents required for Admission.

A limited number of guest rooms may be available on a chargeable basis, subject to availability and allotment on a first-come, first-served basis. In view of the large number of candidates expected during the admission period, the Institute may not be in a position to arrange accommodation for parents/guardians.

Several hotels and lodging facilities are available in Bhagalpur city and adjoining areas, approximately 5–7 km from the Institute campus. Candidates and accompanying persons are advised to make accommodation arrangements in advance, if required.

Once the seat is allotted to the candidate issuing a “Provisional Seat Allotment letter” by the competent authority of the JoSAA 2026 and /or CSAB Special Rounds 2026 the candidates are instructed to report the Institute to complete the admission process. Provisional acceptance means that the candidate has accepted the offer, but the final acceptance is contingent on successful verification of certificates by, and on joining, the provisionally allotted institute and payment of the balance Institute fee (₹1,08,621for GEN/OBC/EWS and ₹1,48,621 for SC/ST/PwD) and Hostel charges (₹41,000 (inclusive of advance against mess charges). While hostel accommodation is mandatory for all first-year students, exemptions may be granted under specific circumstances, such as medical grounds or if the student's parents reside in Bhagalpur. In such cases, students may be permitted to join the institute without being allotted a hostel.

The admission process has been designed to provide a smooth and hassle-free reporting experience. Various admission and onboarding activities are organized in parallel to minimize waiting time. Candidates may obtain hostel room allotment and settle their belongings before completing the remaining admission formalities, while fee submission and reconciliation may be completed at a later stage during the reporting process.
Under normal circumstances, candidates who have completed the prescribed requirements are expected to complete the admission process within approximately 25 minutes.
Dedicated help desks will be available to assist candidates and parents throughout the admission process.
The Institute fee for the First Semester is ₹1,78,621 for all students, irrespective of category or parental income.
Candidates admitted through JoSAA 2026/CSAB 2026 shall pay only the balance Institute fee after adjustment of the Seat Acceptance Fee already paid to JoSAA/CSAB, as applicable.

Multiple payment options including UPI, NEFT/RTGS, Internet Banking, Debit/Credit Cards, and Bank Challan shall be available. Students may pay the prescribed fee through multiple transactions; however, the total fee must be paid in full on or before the notified deadline.

The link for online fee payment shall be made available from 13.08.2026 through the Institute Admission Portal. Candidates are advised to regularly check the portal for updates, payment instructions, and important announcements.
The Institute is committed to ensuring that financial considerations do not become a barrier for deserving students in pursuing their academic aspirations.

Officials from participating banks will be available during the admission process to guide and facilitate education loan applications. Subject to the respective bank's norms and sanction process, eligible students may avail loans covering Institute fees, hostel charges, books, laptop/computer, and other admissible educational expenses, including the balance Institute fee payable at the time of admission.

The Institute will facilitate the issuance of the necessary documents required for loan processing. IIIT Bhagalpur does not endorse or recommend any particular bank and prospective Students are advised to choose it as per their preference and convenience.

Students will be introduced to various aspects of Institute life during the Induction Program. Information regarding scholarships, academic curriculum, programme-specific opportunities, hostel and campus facilities, academic regulations, student support services, internships, research opportunities, and other important matters will be shared through dedicated sessions.

IIIT Bhagalpur is a residential institute with hostel, dining, sports, recreation, and student activity facilities available on campus. The Institute provides a conducive environment for learning, innovation, and holistic student development. With cutting-edge labs, industry tie-ups, experienced faculty, and continuous mentorship, we empower students to become the leaders of tomorrow. A vibrant student life, excellent infrastructure, emphasis on innovation, and extracurricular activities ensure the overall development of every learner which is reflected in the fact that our alumni are gradually getting placed in top-tier companies across the globe, making us a trusted brand for recruiters. Our graduates continue to achieve remarkable success in placement drives conducted by leading national and international companies. For the recent graduating batch, the highest package offered was ₹60 LPA, with an average package of approximately ₹11.3 LPA.

Any other relevant information or changes in the above-mentioned information will be displayed time to time on Institute website. Students are advised to visit Institute website regularly. relevant_lines.text: Admissions to B.Tech degree programs in Chemical Science & Technology, Civil Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Mathematics and Computing, and Mechanical Engineering at NIT Mizoram in the year 2026 are only through seats allocated during Central Counseling conducted by The Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA) and Central Seat Allocation Board (CSAB).

As announced through JoSAA 2026 schedule, there will be five rounds of seat allocation. After the JoSAA rounds conclude, any vacant seats in the NIT+ System will be filled through CSAB Special Rounds conducted via the official CSAB portal (https://csab.nic.in). This year CSAB-Special and DASA (Direct Admission of Students Abroad) have been brought under one umbrella. DASA & CSAB-Special 2026 shall have two rounds of seat allocation. Interested candidates in CSAB-Special 2026 must complete fresh registration after completion of JoSAA rounds, noting that all processes – including registration, choice filling/locking, seat allotment, and fee payment – differ from JoSAA procedures. The document verification for DASA candidates shall be done prior to seat allotment. The same for CSAB candidates shall be done during the rounds. For more information, please visit: https://csab.nic.in
Reservation of seats is as per the rules of Govt. of India, as allocated through the Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA) 2026 and CSAB Special 2026.

Admissions (CCMT) and admissions are conducted on the basis of valid GATE score. For the admission in the Self Sponsored Category, candidates are shortlisted for written test on the basis of required qualification and the qualified candidates are called for personal interview for final selection.

The Institute provides facilities for research leading to the Degree of Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Engineering, Science, Humanities and Social Sciences in various disciplines. For the admission in the Ph.D. program, candidates are shortlisted for written test on the basis of required qualification (GATE/NET/SET qualified). The qualified candidates are called for personal interview. After qualifying, the candidates are provisionally admitted for Ph.D. in the Institute. Their registration for Ph.D. program at the Institute is confirmed only after successful completion of Pre-Registration viva-voce.
